Project Report

• Name of the Project: Terracotta Ganesha idol making
• ⁠Name of the Club: Rotary Club of Mumbai Kalakar
• ⁠Where: Sree Sainath Boudhik Vikalag Mulanchi Karyashala (School for Special Needs Adults)
• ⁠For Whom: Young adults with various levels of autism
• ⁠Number of beneficiaries: 12
• ⁠Cost of the Project: ₹1000
• ⁠Avenue: Vocational
• ⁠Name of the Club President: Rtn Suparna Chakravarty Mukherjee
• ⁠Project Chair: Rtn PP Haima Deshpande
• ⁠Project Brief: Facilitator Sonali Bijur, a Rotarian from Dist 3142 conducted the workshop for young adults with special needs.
Using terracotta clay as the medium, Sonali guided them to make their own idols.
Each of these children had their own perception of the way Ganesha was with the only common idea being the trunk of the deity.
The shapes varied but under Sonali’s guidance they made idols that they have seen in photographs, in temples or in public spaces.
They sang Ganpati bhajans and offered obeisance to the idol.
location: Sree Sainath Boudhik Vikalang Mulanchi Karyashala. Thane, Mumbai, Maharashtra
